nuScenes scene membership data

The official scene-name memberships in src/visual_utils/nuscenes/splits.py
are reproduced from the nuScenes devkit's nuscenes/utils/splits.py.
Attribution: Holger Caesar and the nuScenes devkit contributors.
Upstream: https://github.com/nutonomy/nuscenes-devkit
The devkit is distributed under Apache License 2.0; its license terms are
reproduced in APACHE_LICENSE.txt. No nuScenes SDK code is imported at runtime.

The nominal HDL-32E timing model follows conventions documented by NVIDIA
NCore's nuScenes converter and is an independent NumPy implementation.
Reference: https://nvidia.github.io/ncore/conversions/nuscenes/nuscenes.html
